Charles, saw Carefeed opened a Chicago tech hub to double down on AI while already serving over 2,000 senior care communities.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Carefeed needs this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
